ui.requirement: Sign-in with password and Google, session restore, sign-out and Guest access through an invitation link, exercised through the browser against the real backend.

api.requirement: Sign-in, token refresh, sign-out, current user, and the Guest verification and session endpoints.

notImplemented.former UC-09: No unlock function: there is no account lock besides the sign-in rate limit, which expires by itself.

ui.requirement: Administration of user accounts: list and search, create, update, deactivate and reactivate, role assignment and password reset by email link.

api.requirement: User account endpoints for the System Admin and the public password-reset completion.

ui.requirement: Role and permission matrix, role management, audit log, and the capability gate on screens and endpoints.

api.requirement: Role, capability matrix and audit log endpoints, and the 401/403/404 rules they enforce.

ui.requirement: Meeting lifecycle through the screens: create, edit and reschedule, list and detail, submit, approve or reject, publish, start, end and cancel.

api.requirement: Meeting create, update, list, detail, readiness, status transitions and status history.

ui.requirement: Agenda tab: view, add, edit, delete and reorder items, set the current item, complete an item and record its conclusion.

api.requirement: Agenda item endpoints and their state rules.

ui.requirement: Participants tab: view, add internal people, invite and revoke Guests, change roles and rights, respond to the invitation, response status, attendance and chair handover.

api.requirement: Participant, Guest invitation, invitation response, attendance and chair handover endpoints.

ui.requirement: Personal library (upload, rename, move, delete, folders), the Admin view of a locked account's library, meeting documents (add, remove, link to agenda items, view, download), comments and read confirmation.

api.requirement: Personal library, folder, meeting document, agenda link, comment and read confirmation endpoints.

ui.requirement: Online room over LiveKit for internal users and Guests: join and leave, devices, participants, moderation, chat, floating window, requests to speak and the Secretary's meeting notes.

api.requirement: Call room, LiveKit webhook, requests to speak and meeting notes endpoints.

ui.requirement: Recordings tab and the room: room-mic takes, per-person microphone clips, uploaded audio, playback, download, deleting takes and recordings, and managing one's own recorded speech.

api.requirement: Recording, take, upload part, playback, download and speech clip endpoints.

notImplemented.former UC-51: Publish Meeting Summary is a placeholder.

ui.requirement: Transcript view, edit and speaker attribution, the AI summary draft (generate, view, edit, approve), Voice ID with consent, and voice samples collected by the Secretary.

api.requirement: Transcription, transcript editing, speaker attribution, summary, Voice ID and voice collection endpoints.

ui.requirement: Votes tab: list and results, create and configure drafts, vote documents, open, cast (internal and Guest), close and record the conclusion.

api.requirement: Vote, ballot, vote document and conclusion endpoints and their state rules.

notImplemented.former UC-62: Sign Meeting Minutes is a placeholder (SCRUM-37).

ui.requirement: Minutes tab: generate the draft from the fixed template, view, edit with preview, export to Word, submit, approve and issue, return for revision, and correct issued minutes.

api.requirement: Minutes generation, read, edit, export and approval workflow endpoints.

ui.requirement: Notification bell and panel, mark as read, open the target, real-time delivery, and the emails the workflow sends.

api.requirement: Notification list, unread count, read state and target endpoints, and the email delivery webhook.

ui.requirement: Meeting report: the key figures, the query over the main tables, and the Excel export of the viewed table.

api.requirement: Meeting report, report query and export endpoints.

ui.requirement: Working calendar, calendar sharing (request, share, respond, change, withdraw, end), the shared week and finding a meeting time.

api.requirement: Calendar sharing, shared week, meeting time search and draft-from-slot endpoints.
